summary: St. Joe National Forest crow's nest in Shoshone County, built in the 1930s and listed as abandoned; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned; no source says what, if anything, remains at the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in

events.note: Crow's nest in the 1930s (decade only); no abandonment year given in any source

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives Honey Jones Peak the status Abandoned, and both site pages say Abandoned. None of the sources says the structure is gone.

sources.title: Honey Jones Peak Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Thin: two site pages and the FFLA list, and two searches found nothing else. No source gives an abandonment year, so the only event is the 1930s crow's nest, recorded with a decade-only year. Record kind is platform; the FFLA list types it Crowsnest. Left unchanged. Record status gone is not supported; the sources say Abandoned.
